auth_events_subject_digest_valid.name: auth_events_subject_digest_valid
auth_events_subject_digest_valid.value: ("auth_events"."subject_digest" is null or "auth_events"."event" = 'sign_in_failed') and ("auth_events"."subject_digest" is null or "auth_events"."subject_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

auth_events_session_required.name: auth_events_session_required
auth_events_session_required.value: "auth_events"."event" not in ('sign_in', 'session_ended') or "auth_events"."session_id" is not null

cancellation_requests_review_consistent.name: cancellation_requests_review_consistent
cancellation_requests_review_consistent.value: ("cancellation_requests"."status" = 'open') = ("cancellation_requests"."reviewed_at" is null) and ("cancellation_requests"."reviewed_at" is null) = ("cancellation_requests"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null)

customer_accounts_no_secrets.name: customer_accounts_no_secrets
customer_accounts_no_secrets.value: "customer_accounts"."access_token" is null and "customer_accounts"."refresh_token" is null and "customer_accounts"."id_token" is null and ("customer_accounts"."password" is null or "customer_accounts"."provider_id" = 'credential')

order_events_actor_user_consistent.name: order_events_actor_user_consistent
order_events_actor_user_consistent.value: ("order_events"."actor_type" in ('system', 'customer') and "order_events"."actor_user_id" is null) or ("order_events"."actor_type" = 'user' and "order_events"."actor_user_id" is not null and "order_events"."actor_ref" = "order_events"."actor_user_id"::text)

order_items_name_present.name: order_items_name_present
order_items_name_present.value: "order_items"."product_name_en" is not null or "order_items"."product_name_bn" is not null

orders_payment_status_derived.name: orders_payment_status_derived
orders_payment_status_derived.value: "orders"."payment_status" = case when "orders"."cod_collected_paisa" = 0 then 'unpaid' when "orders"."cod_collected_paisa" < "orders"."total_paisa" then 'partially_collected' when "orders"."cod_settled_paisa" + "orders"."cod_deducted_paisa" < "orders"."cod_collected_paisa" then 'collected' else 'settled' end

orders_fulfilment_consistent.name: orders_fulfilment_consistent
orders_fulfilment_consistent.value:
("orders"."order_status" in ('pending_verification', 'verification_expired') and "orders"."fulfilment_status" = 'unfulfilled')
        or ("orders"."order_status" = 'cancelled' and "orders"."fulfilment_status" in ('unfulfilled', 'packed'))
        or ("orders"."order_status" = 'confirmed')
        or ("orders"."order_status" = 'closed' and "orders"."fulfilment_status" in ('delivered', 'rto_received'))

orders_closed_after_return_window.name: orders_closed_after_return_window
orders_closed_after_return_window.value: "orders"."order_status" <> 'closed' or "orders"."fulfilment_status" <> 'delivered' or ("orders"."delivered_at" is not null and "orders"."closed_at" > "orders"."delivered_at" + interval '7 days')

payment_entries_refund_consistent.name: payment_entries_refund_consistent
payment_entries_refund_consistent.value: ("payment_entries"."kind" = 'refunded') = ("payment_entries"."method" is not null) and ("payment_entries"."kind" = 'refunded') = ("payment_entries"."return_id" is not null)

policy_drafts_bodies_valid.name: policy_drafts_bodies_valid
policy_drafts_bodies_valid.value: btrim("policy_drafts"."body_en") <> '' and length("policy_drafts"."body_en") <= 20000 and btrim("policy_drafts"."body_bn") <> '' and length("policy_drafts"."body_bn") <= 20000

policy_drafts_review_consistent.name: policy_drafts_review_consistent
policy_drafts_review_consistent.value: ("policy_drafts"."reviewed_at" is null) = ("policy_drafts"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null) and ("policy_drafts"."reviewed_at" is null or ("policy_drafts"."body_en" is not null and "policy_drafts"."body_bn" is not null))

policy_publications_content_consistent.name: policy_publications_content_consistent
policy_publications_content_consistent.value: case when "policy_publications"."event" = 'published' then "policy_publications"."draft_version" >= 1 and btrim("policy_publications"."body_en") <> '' and btrim("policy_publications"."body_bn") <> '' and length("policy_publications"."body_en") <= 20000 and length("policy_publications"."body_bn") <= 20000 and "policy_publications"."body_en_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "policy_publications"."body_bn_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' else "policy_publications"."draft_version" is null and "policy_publications"."body_en" is null and "policy_publications"."body_bn" is null and "policy_publications"."body_en_sha256" is null and "policy_publications"."body_bn_sha256" is null end

product_categories_name_present.name: product_categories_name_present
product_categories_name_present.value: "product_categories"."name_en" is not null or "product_categories"."name_bn" is not null

product_categories_names_valid.name: product_categories_names_valid
product_categories_names_valid.value: btrim("product_categories"."name_en") <> '' and length("product_categories"."name_en") <= 100 and btrim("product_categories"."name_bn") <> '' and length("product_categories"."name_bn") <= 100

product_media_alt_valid.name: product_media_alt_valid
product_media_alt_valid.value: btrim("product_media"."alt_en") <> '' and length("product_media"."alt_en") <= 300 and btrim("product_media"."alt_bn") <> '' and length("product_media"."alt_bn") <= 300

product_publication_events_rule_consiste.name: product_publication_events_rule_consistent
product_publication_events_rule_consiste.value: ("product_publication_events"."event" = 'published') = ("product_publication_events"."rule_id" is not null) and ("product_publication_events"."rule_id" is null or "product_publication_events"."rule_id" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,63}$')

products_name_present.name: products_name_present
products_name_present.value: "products"."name_en" is not null or "products"."name_bn" is not null

products_names_valid.name: products_names_valid
products_names_valid.value: btrim("products"."name_en") <> '' and length("products"."name_en") <= 200 and btrim("products"."name_bn") <> '' and length("products"."name_bn") <= 200

products_descriptions_valid.name: products_descriptions_valid
products_descriptions_valid.value: btrim("products"."description_en") <> '' and length("products"."description_en") <= 5000 and btrim("products"."description_bn") <> '' and length("products"."description_bn") <= 5000

products_content_valid.name: products_content_valid
products_content_valid.value:
btrim("products"."fabric_en") <> '' and length("products"."fabric_en") <= 1000 and btrim("products"."fabric_bn") <> '' and length("products"."fabric_bn") <= 1000
        and btrim("products"."care_en") <> '' and length("products"."care_en") <= 1000 and btrim("products"."care_bn") <> '' and length("products"."care_bn") <= 1000
        and btrim("products"."size_guidance_en") <> '' and length("products"."size_guidance_en") <= 1000 and btrim("products"."size_guidance_bn") <> '' and length("products"."size_guidance_bn") <= 1000

products_fabric_confirmation_consistent.name: products_fabric_confirmation_consistent
products_fabric_confirmation_consistent.value: ("products"."fabric_confirmed_at" is null) = ("products"."fabric_confirmed_by_user_id" is null) and ("products"."fabric_confirmed_at" is null or "products"."fabric_en" is not null or "products"."fabric_bn" is not null)

quarantine_items_inspection_consistent.name: quarantine_items_inspection_consistent
quarantine_items_inspection_consistent.value: ("quarantine_items"."status" = 'awaiting_inspection') = ("quarantine_items"."inspected_at" is null) and ("quarantine_items"."inspected_at" is null) = ("quarantine_items"."inspected_by_user_id" is null) and ("quarantine_items"."status" = 'restocked') = ("quarantine_items"."restock_movement_id" is not null)

returns_dates_consistent.name: returns_dates_consistent
returns_dates_consistent.value: ("returns"."status" = 'requested') = ("returns"."received_at" is null) and ("returns"."status" in ('requested', 'received')) = ("returns"."decided_at" is null) and ("returns"."status" = 'completed') = ("returns"."completed_at" is not null)

stock_count_lines_count_consistent.name: stock_count_lines_count_consistent
stock_count_lines_count_consistent.value: ("stock_count_lines"."counted" is null) = ("stock_count_lines"."counted_at" is null) and ("stock_count_lines"."counted" is null) = ("stock_count_lines"."basis_on_hand" is null) and ("stock_count_lines"."counted" is null) = ("stock_count_lines"."basis_movement_id" is null)

stock_count_lines_applied_consistent.name: stock_count_lines_applied_consistent
stock_count_lines_applied_consistent.value: "stock_count_lines"."movement_id" is null or ("stock_count_lines"."applied_delta" is not null and "stock_count_lines"."applied_delta" <> 0)

stock_counts_close_consistent.name: stock_counts_close_consistent
stock_counts_close_consistent.value: ("stock_counts"."status" = 'draft') = ("stock_counts"."closed_at" is null) and ("stock_counts"."closed_at" is null) = ("stock_counts"."closed_by_user_id" is null)

stock_movements_delta_valid.name: stock_movements_delta_valid
stock_movements_delta_valid.value: "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" <> 0 and ("stock_movements"."movement_type" not in ('receipt', 'return_restock') or "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0) and ("stock_movements"."movement_type" <> 'dispatch' or "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0)

stock_movements_reason_valid.name: stock_movements_reason_valid
stock_movements_reason_valid.value: ("stock_movements"."movement_type" <> 'adjustment' or "stock_movements"."reason" is not null) and btrim("stock_movements"."reason") <> '' and length("stock_movements"."reason") <= 500

stock_movements_actor_user_consistent.name: stock_movements_actor_user_consistent
stock_movements_actor_user_consistent.value: ("stock_movements"."actor_type" = 'system' and "stock_movements"."actor_user_id" is null) or ("stock_movements"."actor_type" = 'user' and "stock_movements"."actor_user_id" is not null and "stock_movements"."actor_ref" = "stock_movements"."actor_user_id"::text)

stock_reservations_end_consistent.name: stock_reservations_end_consistent
stock_reservations_end_consistent.value:
("stock_reservations"."status" = 'active' and "stock_reservations"."ended_at" is null and "stock_reservations"."release_reason" is null)
        or ("stock_reservations"."status" = 'released' and "stock_reservations"."ended_at" is not null and "stock_reservations"."release_reason" in ('cancelled', 'expired'))
        or ("stock_reservations"."status" = 'consumed' and "stock_reservations"."ended_at" is not null and "stock_reservations"."release_reason" is null)

store_settings_texts_valid.name: store_settings_texts_valid
store_settings_texts_valid.value: coalesce(length("store_settings"."store_name"), 1) between 1 and 60 and coalesce(length("store_settings"."line_en"), 0) <= 200 and coalesce(length("store_settings"."line_bn"), 0) <= 200 and coalesce(length("store_settings"."contact_phone"), 0) <= 30 and coalesce(length("store_settings"."contact_email"), 0) <= 120 and coalesce(length("store_settings"."contact_whatsapp"), 0) <= 30 and coalesce(length("store_settings"."contact_messenger"), 0) <= 200

store_settings_logo_consistent.name: store_settings_logo_consistent
store_settings_logo_consistent.value: ("store_settings"."logo_base64" is null) = ("store_settings"."logo_sha256" is null) and ("store_settings"."logo_base64" is null) = ("store_settings"."logo_width" is null) and ("store_settings"."logo_base64" is null) = ("store_settings"."logo_content_type" is null) and coalesce(length("store_settings"."logo_base64"), 0) <= 700000 and ("store_settings"."logo_content_type" is null or "store_settings"."logo_content_type" in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'))

store_settings_rule_consistent.name: store_settings_rule_consistent
store_settings_rule_consistent.value: ("store_settings"."rule_approved_at" is null) = ("store_settings"."rule_approved_by_user_id" is null) and ("store_settings"."rule_approved_at" is null or "store_settings"."rule_items" is not null)

variants_labels_valid.name: variants_labels_valid
variants_labels_valid.value: btrim("variants"."size") <> '' and length("variants"."size") <= 64 and btrim("variants"."colour") <> '' and length("variants"."colour") <= 64
